messages:
mira: Hey team — hitting failures spinning up new Dedicated clusters in eu2. Control plane keeps flapping with errors about IP allocation and NAT egress. Anyone seen this pattern before?

kevin: Which VNet / subnet are you provisioning into?

mira: We're using a /20 (10.4.0.0/20) and creating multiple /24s for k8s nodepools + mgmt. Errors show pods failing to pull images from marketplace via PrivateLink sometimes. Logs: 
```
E0423 12:11:05 kubelet.go:123] failed to create sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to allocate IP: no available addresses
HTTP 403: Marketplace image access denied via privatelink endpoint
```

sonia: Two things to check: SNAT port exhaustion on the NAT gateways and whether the PrivateLink endpoints are in the same subnet/route table as your cluster nodes. Azure's NAT gateway SNAT is per-public-ip and per-VM. If we have many short-lived pods + image pulls, SNAT ports run out.

raj: Also confirm subnet delegation and service endpoints for marketplace. Marketplace images over PrivateLink need the PrivateLink to be configured on the same VNet region and the service provider approval done. We saw a similar issue in us-west where images fell back to the internet and hit org firewall rules.

mira: Good call. Current design: 3 worker subnets (/24 each), 1 mgmt /26, 1 privatelink subnet /28. We're seeing around 30k ephemeral connections per hour during canaries. NAT gateway has 1 public IP attached.

kevin: That's the smoking gun — single public IP -> ~64k SNAT ports but Azure reserves some, so effective ports < 64k. With concurrent ephemeral connections and kubelet image pulls, we can saturate. Short-term fix: attach more public IPs to the NAT gateway or enable multiple NAT gateways per subnet. Medium-term: use egress-optimized model (private image caching or Azure Container Registry with Private Endpoint).

mira: Can someone open a quota/limit request with cloud ops for additional public IPs + a GPU quota bump? We also need ND A100 quota for Dedicated pools in eu2: current cores: 0, want 40 (5 x Standard_ND96asr_A100).

sonia: I can file the support ticket. Need exact SKUs and subscription IDs. Put the desired increase and justification. Example payload I'll use: 
```
Subscription: sub-0a1b2c
Region: eu2
Quota change: Standard_ND96asr_A100 -> 40 vCPU count for 5 instances (requesting 5 x ND96)
NAT: additional Public IPs for NAT gateway -> +3 (total 4)
Reason: Production Dedicated clusters for inference, high concurrent egress for image pulls and telemetry. Timeline: asap, 2 week SLA desired.
```

mira: Thanks. Also, we should split the /20 into more, to avoid hitting Azure per-subnet resource limits. Proposal: make dedicated node subnets with /23s instead of /24s and reserve a /26 pool for privatelink and service endpoints for image pulls and ACR Private Endpoint.

raj: Note: When you split, update route tables so the privatelink subnet has a UDR to force image traffic through the privatelink peering. Also add service endpoint for Microsoft.ContainerRegistry.

kevin: We should also create a centralized egress VNet with a scaling NAT cluster and peer the app VNets to it (vnet peering) — reduces duplicate public IPs per VNet. Peering in eu2 is regional and supports transitive routing with user-defined routes if we enable gateway transit.

mira: Is there any quota for number of peerings per VNet? I think default is 500 but some accounts have lower. If we centralize, we'll keep peering count small.

infra-bot: quota-bot: Support ticket created: #CLD-39421 — Requesting GPU quota increase (ND96) + 3 Public IPs for NAT. Assigned to cloud-ops. ETA 72h.

sonia: I'll follow up with cloud-ops in the ticket and attach the network diagram + Canaries traffic graph. Also will ask for expedited review because Dedicated infra is blocking rollout.

mira: For the immediate workaround, I'll spin up a secondary NAT gateway in the same subnet and attach 2 extra Public IPs, and add a small ACR cache VM with Private Endpoint to serve marketplace images. Will post the commands.

kevin: Commands for extra NAT IPs (azure cli):
```
az network public-ip create -g infra-eu2 -n nat-pip-2 --sku Standard --allocation-method Static
az network public-ip create -g infra-eu2 -n nat-pip-3 --sku Standard --allocation-method Static
az network nat gateway ip-config create -g infra-eu2 --gateway-name ngw-cluster --public-ip-address nat-pip-2
az network nat gateway ip-config create -g infra-eu2 --gateway-name ngw-cluster --public-ip-address nat-pip-3
```

mira: Copying that now. I'll also add a pod egress rate limit to give us breathing room during canaries.

raj: After quota increases land, let's schedule a postmortem doc and add an automation check: if SNAT port utilization > 70% alert and autoscale NAT IPs.

mira: Agreed. Thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canaries temporarily paused for clusters in eu2 until NAT changes applied (paused at 12:32 UTC).
